en: A black and white aerial photograph of a mid-20th-century institutional complex surrounded by open fields and some residential buildings. The area is laid out in a planned fashion with several large rectangular buildings arranged with significant open space between them, likely indicating a hospital, sanatorium, or university campus. There are some tree-lined areas and the landscape looks northern European.
